messages:
Priya Rao: Quick heads-up — planning to enable mosaic-v2 in the model-catalog during the 15:00–16:00 UTC change window (4h from now). This will be a staged pin: canary -> regional -> global. Release notes attached below.

deploy-bot: Scheduled enable: model=mosaic-v2, mode=staged, canary_regions=[us-east-1], rollout_steps=3, ticket=ENG-4921. Estimated duration: 45m.

Sam Lin: Do we have a fallback ordering defined? I want to make sure we don't flip to a quant variant accidentally.

Alice Gomez: Fallback priority for mosaic-v2: 1) mosaic-v1 (full precision), 2) mosaic-v1-quant (int8), 3) nexus-small (compat). We'll pin mosaic-v1 as the first fallback. No auto-quant promotion.

Mateo Rivera: Release note snippet for GA customers (short): "mosaic-v2 reduces latency by ~20% on long chats; use-case: streaming generation; fallback to mosaic-v1 on errors." Any objections?

Sam Lin: Sounds good. Add a line about model signature compatibility and tokenization parity.

Priya Rao: Good call. Also, ops guardrails: if API error-rate jump > 5% for 5m in canary region, deploy-bot should abort and rollback to pinned mosaic-v1. If median p95 latency increases by > 150ms sustained 10m, trigger manual review.

Jenna (oncall): I'll set up a short dashboard and a pager rule for the canary: rule name=canary-mosaic-v2-errorrate, threshold=5pct, window=5m. I can toggle off if noisy.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: model artifacts checksum OK, quantization profile not applied, infra capacity check OK (gpu-pools: 8 available), canary traffic target=2% of prod.

Alice Gomez: Quick preflight test to run locally before enabling:
```
# smoke prompt
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"mosaic-v2","input":"Summarize: Redwood platform mission"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Expect: 1) no crash, 2) coherent summary, 3) streaming chunks under 200ms first-chunk.

Mateo Rivera: For release notes in console, I'll include a short migration note: "No prompt changes required. If you rely on exact token-level completions, validate your eval sets."

Sam Lin: One more ops ask — ensure canary logs have debug-level kv-cache misses and batching histogram. We need to confirm batching behavior under short conversations.

Priya Rao: Agreed. Observability checklist: cost-per-token baseline, latency p50/p95, error-rate, kv-cache-hit-rate, batch-sizes histogram. Jenna please confirm dashboards wired.

Jenna (oncall): Dashboard wired. Alerting test sent. All good.

deploy-bot: Begin step 1: enabling canary in us-east-1 at 1799965500. Canary traffic=2%.

Priya Rao: Monitoring now. Team, please watch the canary channels for the next 15m. If we see any red flags call rollback.

Sam Lin: Observing logs — first 3 minutes look clean. batch-size median=8, kv-hit=78%.

Alice Gomez: Noted a slight uptick in 95th tail at 6m: +60ms. Still within threshold. Continue.

Jenna (oncall): Alert fired at 10m for p95 165ms in us-east-1. Investigating.

Priya Rao: Hold. Do not progress rollout. Jenna, what's the scope — single AZ or regional?

Jenna (oncall): Looks regional to us-east-1 across 2 AZs. Error-rate stable, only latency spike.

Sam Lin: Could be transient scheduling on that GPU pool. Restarting a subset of workers might help. Alice, any quick config to try?

Alice Gomez: Will try draining and reprovisioning 2 nodes in that pool, keep canary traffic at 2%.

deploy-bot: Pausing step 2. Notifying owners.

Priya Rao: Thx. If latency normalizes within 15m, we can continue. If not — rollback to mosaic-v1.

Jenna (oncall): After drain and reprovision, p95 back to baseline at +10m. No further alerts.

Sam Lin: Looks stable for 20m. Recommend proceed to regional ramp to 10%. :thumbsup:

Priya Rao: Proceeding. deploy-bot, start step 2.

deploy-bot: Step 2 started: regional ramp to 10% at 1799965600.

Mateo Rivera: I'll update the public release notes and Console blurb: "mosaic-v2 staged rollout — expect initial canaries scaling this hour; full rollout over 2–4 hours if stable."

Priya Rao: Final check: rollback thresholds restated in ticket ENG-4921. After global enable, we'll mark release notes GA and send a short customer email.

Jenna (oncall): I'll keep monitoring for the next 2 hours and maintain the temporary alert rules.

Sam Lin: Thanks all — nice coordination.

Priya Rao: Closing thread for now. Will post final status when global enable completes or if rollback occurs. :rocket:
